prompt: A toy-brick instruction-booklet page for a small model, drawn as a clean numbered STEP diagram. The booklet has SIX numbered build steps shown down the left as a checklist strip, and a panel on the right that shows the running tallies AT STEP 5 (the build has been executed through step 5; step 6 is not done yet). The steps are: Step 1 lay a base plate of 6 grey bricks (0 red); Step 2 add side walls of 8 bricks, 4 of them red; Step 3 is a CORRECTION step: REMOVE the 2 red placeholder bricks and REPLACE them with 1 grey hinge brick (so this step takes away 2 red bricks and adds 1 grey brick); Step 4 add a red roof of 7 bricks, 6 of them red; Step 5 add 5 window bricks, 3 of them red; Step 6 (NOT yet built) add a 3-brick antenna, 1 of them red. Execute the build THROUGH STEP 5 only, keeping a running count. In the right-hand panel print 'BRICKS:' followed by the TOTAL number of bricks placed so far, and 'RED:' followed by the number of RED bricks placed so far. Remember step 3 REMOVES 2 red bricks and adds only 1 grey one, and do NOT include step 6. Print ONLY those two running totals as large numbers and the step checklist -- do not print any per-step brick counts, and do not print the step-6 numbers.
easy_question: Never mind how well it is drawn. Does this picture show a toy-brick instruction-booklet page: a numbered build-step checklist with a panel showing running BRICKS and RED tallies? A realistic photo, an illustration, a schematic or a clean diagram ALL count as yes. Answer NO only if the image shows just a blank card or plain panel with none of that shown, or something unrelated. Answer yes or no only.

reference.q_total: On the brick-booklet page, read the number printed after 'BRICKS:' in the right-hand step-5 panel. Read only the printed digits; do NOT recompute. Answer with a whole number only.
reference.q_red: On the brick-booklet page, read the number printed after 'RED:' in the right-hand step-5 panel. Read only the printed digits; do NOT recompute. Answer with a whole number only.
reference.q_steps: How many numbered build steps are shown in the checklist strip down the left side of the booklet page? Answer with a whole number only.
